Sleep apps love showing "deep sleep: 47 minutes."

Uncomfortable truth: no phone can measure deep sleep. Not one. We build a sleep tracker, so we wrote down what these apps CAN measure — and what's marketing.

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/sleep-tracking-apps-accuracy/

I built a 3D racing game that runs in your browser. No install, no account, no servers — and you can still race anyone on Earth via Race Codes.

My lap: 0:41.187. Beat it.

Free demo: https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/play4/

Browser games quietly got good. Real 3D, real physics, loads in 5 seconds, runs on a school Chromebook.

How to find the good ones and skip the ad-farms:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/free-browser-games-no-download/

I made a sleep app with one rule: never lie about the data.

Tracks your night from your phone, wakes you in light sleep, shows which of YOUR habits wreck your sleep. Free in the browser:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/sleep/

The fastest way to fall asleep faster is not a supplement or an app.

It's fixing your wake-up time — including weekends. Here's why that one habit beats everything else combined:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/how-to-fall-asleep-faster/

Catch a team of three. Beat three crowned Guardians. Then your team becomes a Battle Code you can send to anyone on Earth — and they fight it for real.

Creature battling, zero servers. Free demo:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/play3/

A lie-in on Saturday feels like repaying sleep debt.

It works more like jet lag: shifting your wake time 3 hours has roughly the effect of flying across 3 time zones and back every weekend.

More: https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/how-to-fall-asleep-faster/

Everything in my store has a free version you can try in your browser right now — a racing game, a creature battler, a sleep tracker, a park builder.

Pay only if something earns it:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/

Your sleep tracker's stage chart is an educated guess drawn in confident colours.

The numbers actually worth trusting: time asleep, awakenings, efficiency. Here's how to read a sleep app honestly:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/sleep-tracking-apps-accuracy/

Hold SHIFT through a corner. Slide. Watch the charge build — blue, violet, pink. Release and launch.

Anyone can drive the line. Winning is chaining drift into boost into drift.

Free in your browser: https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/play4/

Build a creature park that earns coins even while you're away. Catch critters in the wilds, build habitats, welcome visitors, chase 5 stars.

Cosy tycoon in your browser, free demo:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/play2/

Multiplayer without servers: the game compresses your run into a short text code. Send it over any chat app. Their game recreates it and they compete against the real you.

Works between any two people on Earth. Try it: https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/play4/

The smart alarm is the one sleep-tech feature that genuinely works as advertised.

Light sleep = movement = exactly what a phone detects best. "Wake me when I'm already surfacing" is the right use of the sensor.

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/sleep/

If it takes you under 5 minutes to fall asleep every night, that's usually a sign you're short on sleep — not good at it.

Healthy range is 10–20 min. What to do if you're over 30:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/how-to-fall-asleep-faster/

I built a game about the best part of Spider-Man — the swinging — with none of the lawsuits.

You're a lantern spirit courier above a fog sea. Throw light-ropes, ride the momentum, release at the top of the arc.

Free in your browser: https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/play5/

Most sleep advice is twenty tips presented as if they all matter equally. They don't.

So we ranked them: the 5 changes that actually work, the 3am playbook, and what barely matters. Free 6-page PDF, no catch:

https://tangshiuan.gumroad.com/l/qubre

Honest truth about sleep sounds: rain and brown noise don't put you to sleep. They stop OTHER sounds from waking you. That's it — and it's enough.

Which noise to pick, how loud, and when silence wins:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/best-sounds-for-sleep/

We gave our swinging game the landing page it deserved: scroll, and you fly through the floating islands while the story unfolds. All in the browser, no download.

See it: https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/skyline/

I'm writing a sleep book with one rule: no miracle promises. The launch page even shows which chapters aren't finished yet — honesty as a feature.

Read the three rules it's written by:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/book/

Your sleep score is a recipe, not a measurement — the same night can be a 72 in one app and an 88 in another, and neither is wrong.

How to read yours properly (and the 2 numbers that actually matter):

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/what-is-a-good-sleep-score/

We built a toy that lets you invent your own sleep score. Same night, your recipe: slide the weights and watch one identical night score 45 or 95.

That's how real sleep scores work too. Try it:

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/score-lab/

New free toy: Wildhaven Beatbox. Put critters on stage — each one plays a musical layer, and every combination stays in tune (that's the trick: one key, one tempo).

Made a mix? It copies as a link.

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/beatbox/

The Honest Sleep Book is finished. 14 chapters, ~17,000 words, zero miracle promises — the launch page has shown every chapter's status honestly since day one. Today they all say Written.

Kindle next.

https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/book/

我們的繁中新書上架了：《環境比意志力強》。

不靠意志力，用房間改變習慣——三個原理、十章、每章附插圖，加一個十四天改造計畫。沒有雞湯，沒有編造的研究。

US$3.99：

https://tangshiuan.gumroad.com/l/asvsdb
